_about: The character's first brush with the strange or superhuman world. Separate from the power origin. Subject-less past tense. age: [min,max] when it happened. Original content written for DCUGen.

events.text: Was rescued from a burning apartment by a hero who moved too fast to see clearly.

person.who: {hero}, the speedster who carried {name} out of a fire
person.status: Probably doesn't remember; {name} has never forgotten.

events.text: Was taken hostage in a bank by a villain called {villain} and watched heroes negotiate for {their} life.

person.who: {villain}, the villain who once held {name} hostage

events.fear: Being used as a bargaining chip

events.text: Found an injured alien in a drainage ditch and hid it in the garage for a week.
events.hook: The alien {name} hid as a kid has come back, and it isn't alone.

events.text: Saw a sorcerer's duel in an alley, then woke up the next morning with the memory blurred around the edges.
Was on the bus that a hero lifted off a collapsing bridge.
Was given a business card by a government agent after witnessing something 'that did not happen.'

person.who: {npc}, a tired government agent who handles 'incidents'
person.status: Calls occasionally to ask if {name} has seen anything unusual.

events.text: Lost a home to collateral damage in a fight between two powerhouses.
events.motive: Thinks the super-powered need someone holding them accountable.

events.text: Was a test subject in a 'sleep study' at {lab} that turned out to be about something else entirely.
events.hook: Another former sleep-study subject has been found with burned-out eyes.

events.text: Interned at a hero team's public relations office and learned how the sausage is made.
Was mind-controlled for an afternoon by a villain and did things {they_were} still ashamed of.

complication.text: Terrified of mind control after losing an afternoon to it.

events.text: Spent a night in an emergency shelter during an alien invasion, sharing a cot with a stranger's kid.
Photographed a costumed hero without the mask, and has never shown the picture to anyone.
events.secret: Has a photograph of a hero's unmasked face.

events.text: Was saved from a mugger by a vigilante who left the mugger webbed in {rope|wire|ice|shadow} for the police.
Was a bystander when a villain's death ray carved a line through {street} two feet away.
Worked catering at a gala that was crashed by {villainGroup}.
Was briefly turned into {a statue|a toad|a child|a cartoon} by a magical prank and restored by sunset.
Was in a hospital when a hero brought in a wounded villain and the whole ward held its breath.
Pulled an unconscious hero out of a river and only later realized who it was.

person.who: {hero}, the hero {name} once pulled out of a river
person.status: Owes {name} a life debt and takes it seriously.

events.text: Was recruited as a 'consultant' by a costumed villain who needed {their} expertise.

person.who: {villain}, a villain who once paid well for {name}'s expertise

events.text: Was trapped in a time loop for what felt like a month and lived the same Tuesday over and over.
Watched a ship from another world fall into the sea off {hometown}.
events.hook: Wreckage from the ship off {hometown} is turning up on the black market.

events.text: Wrote a school report on a hero and received a hand-written reply.
Was a juror on a trial where the defendant phased through the courtroom wall.
Found a crashed drone from a villain's arsenal and sold the parts online, which drew unwanted attention.
Was rescued from a cult ritual by a hooded mystic who vanished in smoke.
Was on a plane that a hero caught when the engines failed.
Lived next door to a quiet neighbor who turned out to be a retired super-villain.

person.who: {npc}, the kindly next-door neighbor who used to be the villain {villain}
person.status: Retired; gardens; insists it's all in the past.

events.text: Responded to a call as a first responder and found a costumed fight already in progress.
Was accidentally hit by a hero's power and spent a week glowing faintly.
Was hired to clean up after costumed battles, a job that pays better than anyone guesses.
Covered a superhuman brawl as a cub reporter and got the photo that made {their} name.
Was kidnapped by a villain who had mistaken {them} for someone important.
Played in a schoolyard where a strange kid could lift cars, and kept the secret.
events.secret: Knows the childhood identity of a powered person.

events.text: Was cured of a fatal illness by a healer who asked nothing in return.
events.regret: Never finding the healer to say thank you.

events.text: Saw {their} {parent} argue in hushed tones with a man in a cape on the back porch.
events.secret: Suspects a parent had dealings with costumed people.

events.text: Watched a hero die on live television and remembers exactly where {they} stood.
Stumbled into a hidden headquarters while hiking and was politely escorted out.
events.hook: The hidden headquarters {name} stumbled into has been abandoned, and something was left behind.

events.text: Was part of a crowd a villain tried to turn into a hostile mob, and fought the urge.
Was a lab assistant on a project that accidentally opened a door to another dimension for six seconds.
events.hook: Something came through the door in those six seconds.

events.text: Got a ride home from a hero after a car breakdown and talked the whole way about baseball.
Was briefly possessed by a spirit and woke up speaking a dead language.
Testified at a congressional hearing about superhuman registration.
Was a hero's unwitting decoy in a sting operation and nearly got shot.
Was the first to notice that a famous 'meteor' was slowing down before it landed.
Was among the passengers trapped when a villain froze an entire subway train in ice.
Served drinks at a bar where off-duty heroes and off-duty villains drank on opposite sides of the room.
Found out a childhood friend had powers after watching them stop a falling piano with one hand.

person.who: {npc}, a childhood friend who turned out to have powers
person.status: Operates as {hero} now; they still have lunch monthly.

events.text: Was pulled into a parallel world for a day and came back with sand in {their} shoes from a beach that doesn't exist.
Received a {ring|amulet|wristband|coin} from a dying stranger who said, 'Don't let them have it.'
events.hook: The people the dying stranger warned about have finally found {name}.

events.text: Never saw a hero in person until adulthood, and it was underwhelming: a cape in a traffic jam.
